headline: Contested Sectors Keep the War Ledger Moving
war_summary: Since the last edition, Mooring County has become the liveliest fresh front, with six strategic-base events in two hours and 15 in six; its ledger now shows 11 Warden and one Colonial base. Weathered Expanse also remains fiercely unsettled, adding two events in the latest two hours and 17 in six, with five Warden, one Colonial, and three neutral bases. Palantine Berm records 30 events across the current 24-hour window, including five in six hours, while Nevish Line has five events in six hours and a divided five-to-three Warden advantage. Kuura Strand’s 21-event daily record remains significant, though no event has appeared in the latest two hours. Callahan’s Passage has likewise gone quiet at the immediate edge, despite 19 events in the day and a nine-to-one Warden lead. Fisherman’s Row retains 15 daily events but no recent movement, and most other sectors report little or no strategic-base activity. The newest casualty figures show the heaviest pressure concentrated in Mooring County, Weathered Expanse, and the still-contested central fronts.
